protocol.primary: Own-policy histories only; no fixed-history scores used. Same 12 selected checkpoints as original trajectory.
protocol.sampling: 60K independent fit / 80K test rows per checkpoint; 64 warmup, full 1024-step episodes, 84 test clusters including truncated last episode; ridge 1e-6; greedy actions; full three-state belief, delta=b1-b2, rho=b3.
protocol.bootstrap: 2000 pointwise draws; 10000 unpaired contrast draws with independently resampled episodes, class means recomputed and probes fixed. Underlying checkpoint rollouts reuse PRNG stream keys: independent resampling is the requested convention, not a claim that these common-random-number samples are strictly independent.
protocol.class_standardization: R2=1-sum(q_k*SSE_k/n_k)/sum(q_k*SST_k/n_k). q is final test class proportions, restricted and renormalized to shared peak/final support. Zero-presence bootstrap replicates are invalid, not silently renormalized. This controls class proportions, not within-class visitation or target variance.
protocol.selection: Peak maximizes observed own-history full-h within-class R2 among 12 checkpoints; contrasts condition on selected peak, no selection/multiplicity correction; one training seed only.
protocol.controls: Own-history init/peak/final only. One fixed input-control draw per split; seeds 20261106+10*index+split, labels853. Targets/classes remain original own-policy targets/classes. Input controls are distribution shifts, not required zero nulls.

provenance.import_method: git archive from recorded PR219 SHA; only selected transformer arms and recipe/environment sources retained; no merge/rebase
